description: W1.6 pinned-path Option-1 reference for the q10 Floquet DTC autocorrelator. Both arms consume the banked disorder file; the device-calibrated arm is pinned to the canonical solver top_1 placement through prepare_simulation. The gate compares the device_cal_* columns via pure z_comb (5-sigma).

supersedes.reason: The prior reference was produced on legacy-drawn disorder and an unpinned (free-layout, non-reproducible) device-calibrated placement. This artifact is file-sourced disorder + a pinned canonical placement through the prepare_simulation seam -- a genuinely new artifact, not a re-pin.

device_calibrated.note: canonical solver deterministic top_1 for q10 on Q50 cal 08c3c70f; recorded order, guard-tested (tests/unit/test_canonical_placement_guard.py)

seed_anchor.note: resolve_instance_seed(0, 0); the seed_simulator value shared with the gate's file-disorder/pinned sweep arm, which is what makes the z_comb near-bit-level.

provenance_home: Each run's per-instance full.json records disorder_file + resolved_placement + master_seed + instance_seed (patch 18d). This file projects that run-self-described provenance onto the committed artifact; it is not a separate hand-authored source.
